title: FlyNYON Helicopter Tours
specs: Doors-off flights provide unobstructed views for aerial photography
Flights cover iconic NYC landmarks including Statue of Liberty, Empire State Building, Brooklyn Bridge, and more
Sunset flights offer golden hour lighting and city lights views
Passengers over 310 lbs inclusive of gear must purchase a second seat
Maximum single passenger weight limit 350 lbs inclusive of gear
Children under 2 may fly as lap child on doors-off flights; 2 years and older must purchase seat
Parent or guardian must sign consent form if under 18
Gimbals over 10 lbs subject to pilot approval
Private flights available for groups of 4 to 6 passengers

blurb: FlyNYON provides helicopter flights from Kearny, NJ, with options for doors-off and doors-on experiences. Flights range from 15 to 37 minutes, covering iconic NYC landmarks with customizable routes for photography. The company emphasizes safety, professional pilots, and a unique aerial photography experience.
extraNote: All purchases are nonrefundable · Flight vouchers valid for 12 months · Cancellations by FlyNYON due to weather result in flight voucher refund less insurance cost · No shows or cancellations within 48 hours forfeit full price · Late arrival fee $75 per person if arriving less than 75 minutes before departure · FlyNYON may cancel or reschedule flights due to weather, ATC delays, or other uncontrollable events · Dynamic or surge pricing applies during high demand times · FlyNYON Terminal in Kearny, NJ
